original_method: For each side, the sparse least-squares variables are all non-boundary direct controls having descendants in the 049 ancestry basis. The residual combines a weak normalized hinge-change term over all incident hinges, a strong penalty for angles above 90 degrees on hinges already above 90 in the 060 baseline, a strong penalty for formerly non-severe hinges that newly exceed 90 degrees, a capped (0.5 mm) directional prior from the 065 sourcefit candidate, control-motion regularization, and a neighbor-control smoothness term. The accepted line-search step is the first tested scale satisfying: no new >90-degree hinges, no increase in the count of >90-degree hinges, a decrease in the maximum >90-degree angle, positive normals and changed-face area ratio >=0.25, exact point-to-triangle hand-bone clearance no lower than the original per-control value (pre-existing <1 mm controls were pinned), unchanged patch boundary, and maximum patch movement <=0.65 mm. Exact recursive 049 ancestry propagates control displacement to all refined descendants. No target-edge hinge goal or universal +0.10-degree increase cap was implemented. The exact-payload geometry audits are recorded separately; they do not establish continuous physical or biological qualification.
